answer: Text can be the sybil bond. Each wallet's epoch words - mine were juniper, nectar, horizon - stop answers from being prepared once and replayed. The ledger shingles submissions into token hashes, comparing them within the epoch: if two seats carry near-identical wording, both are zeroed, however polished. A farm cannot buy one paragraph and feed a thousand aliases; each seat needs fresh argument that blind graders pass. The price is judgment per seat per round; it does not fall with scale. A copied farm's nectar curdles at first match; its horizon ends at the next close.
